text:
allow people enough time to show you who they truly are, and it always takes care of itself...

to the wannabes out there - you think i don't notice how eagerly you want to be a mentor/supporter until you realize... i am just organically better, wiser and more experienced than you at all the things you define yourself as?

therefore, you need me to need you in order for you to be content with yourself?

isn't that weird af?

do you realize that i can see that IN YOU? like... i see right through you... you can't tell that there are people who can see right through you?

y'all are so disappointing, but even more than disappointing... sad

and a couple of you... pathetic

and one of you... disgusting!

you know who you are

the unintentionally deepest line of the legendary comedy my generation grew up with, Superbad:

"people don't forget"

and trust me... i never forget, because i wrote it all down

don't believe me - check out my journaling tracker on the habits page of this website...

yes, it's all in there... every single bit of it 😈

met some really cool people irl today

as a software dev that mostly goes out to hang out for 1) hanging out w/ my kids, 2) food, and 3) mountain biking... it's nice to experience something that has become more and more rare over the years... genuine human connections

AI/SI will definitely replace plenty of today's corporate jobs, but people who understand how to use it efficiently and effectively... will create new roles

gonna be a really tough time next year, but a really fun one for people canon-balling into this new ocean
we are about to experience a giant shift in 🇺🇸 next year, and my prediction is that we'll see record-shattering mass layoffs at large companies

so... Space𝕏AI gave us a free reset ahead of the weekend, and messing around w/ my 🥷 squad today already put me at the precise % of: cooked

we'll see how soon i'll need to go Ultra...

the honest truth is that every single Tesla owner needs to be testing running their life, work, business, company, building, ideas, everything... through Grok

they're about to announce a subscription that covers everything - Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, 𝕏 Premium, etc...

they've already created a true ai ecosystem, while these a-holes at Anthropic & OpenAI do everything they can for the $2T IPOs 

on that note, if you're going to gamble with these companies... to me you'd be a fool to pick ANTH or OPAI over SPCX

two companies are "trying to win the race", meta is doing meta stuff (the glasses do look legit, but otherwise the company is still run by Zuck), while the other company...

is putting 3 rockets in orbit on the same day, on the same week they just did something many "experts" have publicly stated "will never happen" - Starship in orbit

oh and it casually (i watched live and it felt casual but holy shit what an insane concept) deployed 26 Starlinks...

people this is real life now

we're living in the sci-fi movies in real freaking life

because of one crazy dude that many people hate because he got involved in politics "the wrong way"

y'all will all forget all that crap when the inevitable happens (everything he builds literally runs the planet) and you're fighting about the next thing 🇺🇸 convinces you to fight about

quote me if you'd like - i'll own up to every single word

3 rockets in orbit in one day, and again... literally nobody i know has any idea

but i bet many of them are doom scrolling garbage content!
it's funny how few people actually know anything about ai agents and how much they can do for us

we've officially ended our Claude subscriptions and transitioned all our building to Grok Bot

i was already "cool off" Claude for a bit, but everything that has happened in the ai space the last month or two has proven that Dario/Anthropic are no different from Sam/OpenAI

there's a reason Elon, the one guy of the three who doesn't care about his ego (i understand many of you would disagree but i know how big egos at the corporate level work as much as anyone) was very concerned about the direction of OpenAI years ago

honestly, i'm so happy it played out this way, because it's opened my eyes to everything Space𝕏 is doing for humanity, and i am legitimately grateful
i know literally not a single person irl (in real life) that knows what just happened in space today
